01 · Valeting

Mini Valet

£40About 2 hoursAt your home or workplace

The Mini Valet is our maintenance clean for cars that are already in decent shape. The outside gets a pre-wash, snow foam and a full hand wash, finished with a hydrophobic rinse coating. Inside, it's vacuumed and wiped down, so the car is clean and tidy without the time and cost of a shampoo.

Book a Mini Valet Not sure? Send photos

Who it's for

  • Newer cars, and cars that are cleaned regularly
  • A tidy-up between Full Valets
  • Cars on a regular cleaning schedule, including Rebel VIP members [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: are VIP maintenance visits based on the Mini Valet?]

The Mini isn't the right choice if the seats or carpets are marked, there's heavy pet hair, or the car hasn't been cleaned in months. It doesn't shampoo fabrics, so the Full Valet will give you a better result. See the Full Valet.

What's included

Exterior

  • Citrus pre-wash to loosen road dirt
  • Snow foam soak
  • Hand contact wash
  • Door shuts cleaned
  • Fuel cap cleaned
  • Hydrophobic rinse coating

Wheels & tyres

  • Wheels cleaned
  • Tyres dressed

Interior

  • Vacuumed throughout, including mats and boot
  • Dashboard wiped down
  • Steering wheel and interior plastics cleaned
  • Windscreen and interior windows cleaned

What isn't included

  • Seats, mats or carpets shampooed (Full Valet)
  • Boot deep clean, air vents, foot pedals and indicator stalks (Full Valet)
  • Leather cleaning and conditioning, roof lining, wheel arches and paint protection (Platinum Valet)
  • Removing swirls or scratches from paint (machine polishing)

Heavy pet hair or a very dirty interior can cost extra. Send us a photo and we'll confirm the price before you book.

Optional extras

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: any add-ons that can be booked with a Mini Valet, with prices. If there are none, remove this section.]

What to expect

A clean, tidy car inside and out. The Mini removes everyday dirt, dust and grime. It won't lift stains from fabric seats or carpets, and it won't remove scratches from the paint. If you can see marks on the seats, the Full Valet is the one to book.

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: which service this job was. Swap the photo if it wasn't a Mini Valet.]

How the Mini compares

Need more than the Mini?

The Full Valet (£65, about 3 hours) includes everything in the Mini and adds:

  • Seats shampooed and extracted (leather cleaned)
  • Mats and carpets shampooed
  • Boot deep cleaned
  • Dashboard cleaned, including air vents
  • Foot pedals and indicator stalks cleaned

Mini Valet questions

Is the car washed by hand?

Yes. Every Mini Valet includes a citrus pre-wash and snow foam to lift the worst of the dirt, followed by a hand contact wash.

What is the hydrophobic rinse coating?

It's applied as part of the final rinse on every wash, and helps water run off the paint. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: product used and how long the effect typically lasts.]

Can I book a Mini if the car hasn't been cleaned for a while?

You can, but the Mini doesn't shampoo fabrics. For a car that's been let go, the Full Valet will give a much better result. Send us a few photos and we'll tell you which one it needs.

How often should I book one?

It depends on how the car is used. If you'd like it done on a schedule, Rebel VIP covers fortnightly or monthly visits.
